poems.note: Both printings separately head and bound five couplets. The 1909 reading has برغم من دلالة مرشدي and ما جمعنا وسائلا لمصلحة; the 1924 version reads برغم السعي والعلم والنهى and ما اتخذنا وسائلا لمنفعة.

The 1909 headnote introduces the description as appearing at the start of an al-Muqtaṭaf article; the 1924 book separately heads the same seven couplets. The 1909 زينة and المساء differ from the later بهجة and السماء.
